truths.statement: The current deployment configuration serves only dist through a loopback static HTTP server; it no longer loads the legacy model environment file or exposes application database endpoints.

Legacy browser namespaces and server databases are retained for explicit migration. Current architecture and local acceptance data are recorded in docs/architecture.json and docs/local-space-validation.json.

dont_assume: Do not treat local persistence as offline inference: remote model requests send selected text to the user-chosen provider.
Do not delete or silently import legacy user data.
